## Interpretation

- The frozen failure is not a single far-distance issue: the inspected buckets include both 30-60 km regressions and near/medium distance Kanto-Chubu examples.
- False positives show strong local observed shaking being propagated into weak stations.
- False negatives show high-mask variants and strong local stations that are not recovered by the current PLUM/JMA max branch.
- Next model changes must be designed on validation diagnostics only; this opened frozen split must not become a tuning set.

## Decision

- Production remains blocked.
- Use these examples to decide whether a new validation gate or model-family revision is required.
